reported_state: Candidate reconciliation separates the source selected-action quotient (A) from its flat detector tangent (B). The Lean source-convention adapter supplies a finite matrix witness for B, maps the source frame by right multiplication with eta into the existing solder Gram carrier, retains the quadratic remainder, and proves both the full matrix-variable Fréchet derivative at the flat frame and its transport through the actual finite solder readout. The sitewise theorem treats the complete finite LocalCoframeField N domain; at each fixed site its derivative is exactly the existing coframeMetricReadout. The matrix derivatives use the Frobenius norm and the field derivative uses the inherited finite Pi norm. No result connects A selected-action quotient to that Lean carrier, establishes global connection elimination or physical metric/source selection, or grants independent C0 acceptance.
